notes: True homograph of the existing H6750 (צָלַל, "tingle; quiver") -- same bare consonants צלל, genuinely unrelated meanings -- added as צלל² (higher Strong's number) per the ascending-Strong's-number superscript convention; H6750 is retroactively renamed צלל¹ in this same batch. H6750's own notes already flagged this exact triple-homonym risk and named this root by its H6751 number specifically.

A third homonym sharing these consonants, H6749 ("tumble down, sink"), is still not in this dataset -- flagged for whoever adds it next; it will need its own superscript (³ by the same ascending-number convention, since both ¹ and ² are now taken).
